summary: SiteDocument models a simple relationship between a document and its associated site.
purpose: To represent documents tied to specific sites within the system and provide simple data structures for referencing them.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the related site.

system_behavior: SiteDocument is a sealed class with two integer properties: ID and SiteID.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET page and code-behind for presenting a welcome dashboard to administrative staff.
purpose: To provide administrators a welcome interface that includes session-based information, last login display, and basic search/filtering of employment applications by site, discipline, and date range.

fields.name: lblTitle
fields.description: Displays a welcome message and user's preferred name.

fields.name: ltlLastLogin
fields.description: Displays last login timestamp and user's timezone.

fields.name: ddSite
fields.description: Filter for selecting a site.

fields.name: ddDiscipline
fields.description: Filter for selecting discipline/subdiscipline.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: Filter for start date of applications.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: Filter for end date of applications.

fields.name: chkShowWithdrawn
fields.description: Show/hide withdrawn applications.

workflows.name: Employment Application Search and Review
steps: Load page, initialize UI controls and filters.
Set default date range to Today minus 3 months to Today.
User selects site and discipline, dates, and optionally includes withdrawn.
User refreshes view; applications are listed in a grid.
Applications can be viewed in detail via a new window.

business_rules: Start date must not be after end date.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end dates.
CustomValidator (checkStartEnd JS) to ensure start date is not after end date.
conditions: pnlLastLogin is only visible if user's last login information exists.
system_behavior: Injects necessary JavaScript for filtering and calendar UI.
Auto-sets default dates, repopulates grid on filter change.
Administrative staff can only see data within their session/agency context.
Grid supports paging and shows applications with status and withdrawn date.
exceptions: UI disables or cancels data load if session is null.

summary: ServiceCode models codes for categorizing services, along with language/description alternatives and database interaction methods.
purpose: To define service categorization codes and facilitate retrieval and localization of these codes for courses and timetables.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: ID of the code category for the service.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short name or code for the service.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Description of the service.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order for sorting service codes.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Additional notes about the service.

fields.name: NameAlt
fields.description: Alternate language description.

fields.name: NotesAlt
fields.description: Alternate language notes.

workflows.name: Fetch Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to retrieve all service codes for a session.
Use ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID to retrieve relevant codes for a specific course or timetable.
Localize service code attributes if session is using alternative language fields.

business_rules: Localization of names and notes is handled based on session language mode.
conditions: If Sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true, alternate language fields are used for Name/Notes.
system_behavior: ServiceCode includes methods to retrieve lists from database and populate properties from database fields.
List methods close SqlDataReader after use; they may throw on DB errors.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks and presents historical actions/changes made to site profiles, including who made the changes and when.
purpose: To allow auditing and display of changes to site profile data, capturing action, user, agency, and other context fields.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history record.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date and time of the action/change.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: UI section where change was made.

fields.name: UserAction
fields.description: Action description performed by the user.

fields.name: Fields
fields.description: Fields that were changed.

fields.name: Agency
fields.description: Agency code where the change happened.

fields.name: AgencyName
fields.description: Name of the agency.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the user who made the change.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the user who made the change.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the user who made the change.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Phone number of the user.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of the user who performed this action.

fields.name: ByOriginalUserID
fields.description: ID of the original user if action was impersonated/delegated.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Was the action performed by a sys admin?

workflows.name: Site Profile Change Tracking
steps: User or system triggers a change to a site profile.
SiteProfileHistorySearch is invoked with parameters SiteID, SessionAgencyID, session object.
For each returned database entry, a SiteProfileHistory record is created and filled with audit info.
Data is displayed to the user showing who changed what and when.

business_rules: If session is in alternative language, alternate field names are used for tracking.
Tooltip details are formatted to show user name, agency, and phone if present.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted returns a formatted string with agency and initials.
AgencyUserDetailsFormatted builds details string with name and agency, and adds phone if present.
conditions: If action is triggered by sys admin or delegated user, formatting may differ.
system_behavior: Search returns audit logs of site profile changes filtered by site and agency.
UI disables search if session is null.
exceptions: Selecting handler cancels operation if UserSession is null.
